_comment: Payer FHIR Provider Directory endpoints for California. Source: third-party AccessMediCal project (https://github.com/jcl347/AccessMediCal, data/fhir-endpoints.json), not an official list. Re-verify before use. 'metadataStatus' is the HTTP status of GET {baseUrl}/metadata, checked 2026-10-31 unless noted.

payers.name: L.A. Care Health Plan
payers.note: No NPI identifiers in sample roles (npi=0).

payers.name: Molina Healthcare of California
payers.note: Near search reportedly returns 500. Resources carry no NPI identifiers (npi=0 in sample).

payers.name: Blue Shield Promise
payers.note: Only endpoint reported with real coordinates.

payers.name: Gold Coast Health Plan
payers.note: README says host is IP-allowlisted; may fail from some networks.

payers.name: CalOptima Health
payers.note: /metadata returns 404 but PractitionerRole search works (checked 2026-10-31). Location.position is empty, so no geo search.

payers.name: Partnership HealthPlan of California
payers.note: /metadata returns 404, but PractitionerRole search works. Gateway is intermittent (502 and timeouts on some calls).

payers.name: Health Net
payers.note: FHIR base behind partners.centene.com login. Public JSON directory dataset exists (healthnet-providers.json) per third-party README.

payers.name: Anthem Blue Cross
payers.note: Metadata public; data queries return 403 without API key/OAuth registration.

payers.name: Kaiser Permanente
payers.note: Gateway returns 406 to FHIR requests. Candidate: https://kpx-service-bus.kp.org/service/hp/mhpo/healthplanproviderv1rc/ (unverified). PDF directories only publicly.

payers.name: Kern Family Health Care
payers.note: No public Provider Directory endpoint found.
